references.text: Earlier in the same chapter, the men of Shechem set an ambush against Abimelech, showing the ongoing hostility between them and providing context for the people going out to the field.
The direct continuation where Abimelech acts on the information he received and sets an ambush against the people who went out to the field.
A similar pattern where the people go out to battle and information is given to a leader, here David being told about Saul's death.
A parallel situation where someone gives strategic information to a leader, here concerning the inhabitants of Ai.
Zebul sends messengers to Abimelech with information, following the same pattern of reporting to Abimelech.
